success_patterns: When a user affirms an offer to provide recommendations, retrieve the relevant cached results so the assistant can fulfill the offer instead of returning “No planning needed.”

patch.reasoning: Two trajectories show the same gap: an affirmative response to an offer to give recommendations is still a request to present results, even when searches are already cached. The skill covers resolving affirmations but does not explicitly distinguish retrieving results for presentation from doing new planning.

edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.
edits.content: When the affirmed proposal was an offer to provide or show recommendations, retrieve the relevant cached results with `get_results_from_cache` so the offer is fulfilled; do not return “No planning needed” or repeat a completed search.
